reason: I took magnesium for a few weeks last year and felt nothing, so I'm not keen to pay nearly £20 to find out again. A gummy with sugar and glucose syrup in it also sits oddly with me for something I'd be taking every day.
objection: I don't know if I'd like the taste or texture, and with no reviews yet I've no way of knowing whether these will do anything when cheap tablets did nothing.
would_change_my_mind: Reviews from women my age saying they noticed a real difference after a month.
